BOARD_DOC: Detected Raspberry Pi family and firmware revision. Detection is waveshare28-config detect.
PANEL_LIVE_DOC: Live backend device. If the firmware overlay is not on this boot yet, this says a reboot is required.
KMS3A_DOC: Read-only. The configurator writes this board's revision filter only when it is missing from volumioconfig.txt. Not a user switch.
SECTION_UI_DESC: Theme, boot status type, and the track strip. Face boxes and surface type are fixed. Bar spacing is kept as a key but does not move the glass.
ROTATION_DOC: Degrees clockwise. fbtft rotate is the counter-clockwise equivalent. The usual landscape mount is 270.
SPEED_DOC: SPI clock. Also the fbtft speed when backend is framebuffer. 32000000 is the reference.
BACKEND_DOC: spi: renderer owns the bus. framebuffer: fbtft stays for Plymouth, renderer mmaps the panel framebuffer.
CONSOLE_DOC: Framebuffer only. release unbinds fbcon so kernel text cannot overwrite the player. share leaves fbcon bound.
HDMI_DOC: Pi 4 family and framebuffer only. Off cancels Volumio's hdmi_force_hotplug so Plymouth can bind this panel. On keeps HDMI for audio or a monitor.
STATUS_TEXT_DOC: Boot overlay only: hostname, addresses and the startup footer. Large is the biggest stock face and wraps a long IPv6 address. The Status surface after the player is up always uses that face. Player title stays as it is.
BAR_GAP_DOC: Kept so a typo is refused. The face boxes are fixed; this key does not move the glass.
STRIP_DOC: The slot between the volume slider and the transport buttons. Progress is elapsed, a bar, and total time when the source publishes a duration. Stream shows IN format from getState (codec, bit depth, sample rate or bitrate). Off leaves the slot blank. Live radio with no duration stays blank in Progress. Does not invent an output format.
THEME_DOC: Colour tokens only. Cover art does not recolour. Accent is the volume fill; progress follows the title colour; danger is mute. Ink is the shipped black, white and orange set. Dusk is dark roast. Studio is deep navy. Night is amber type on a near-black ground. Live after Apply; no reboot.
VERIFY_DOC: Compare derived files against /boot/waveshare28.conf without changing anything.
SECTION_BACKUP_CREATE_DESC: Save the current panel keys on this device. The restore list updates on this page. A name that already exists is overwritten.
BACKUP_NAME_DOC: 1 to 64 letters, numbers, spaces, dots, underscores or hyphens.
SECTION_BACKUP_RESTORE_DESC: Apply a named backup through the same checks as Apply. Rotation, speed, backend, console, hdmi, status text, bar spacing, track strip and theme are restored. Older backups that omit the later keys restore those as defaults.
BACKUP_SELECTED_DOC: Named backups live under /data/INTERNAL/waveshare28/backups and survive plugin uninstall.
SECTION_BACKUP_DELETE_DESC: Remove a named backup from this device. Live settings are not changed.
TOAST_ARMV6: This board is armv6 (Pi 1 / original Pi Zero) and is not supported.
TOAST_NOT_PI: This plugin requires a Raspberry Pi (armv7 or later).
TOAST_REBOOT: Settings saved. A reboot is required for the firmware overlay. Your device will restart in {seconds} seconds.
TOAST_REBOOT_CANCELLED: Reboot cancelled. Settings are already saved; reboot when you can.
TOAST_DRIFT: Configuration has drifted. Apply settings to restore.
TOAST_BACKUP_NAME: Backup name must be 1–64 letters, numbers, spaces, dots, underscores or hyphens.
TOAST_BACKUP_WRITE: Could not write the settings backup.
BACKUP_NO_VALUES: That settings backup has no values.
BACKUP_BAD_ROTATION: That settings backup has an invalid rotation.
BACKUP_BAD_SPEED: That settings backup has an invalid speed.
BACKUP_BAD_BACKEND: That settings backup has an invalid backend.
BACKUP_BAD_CONSOLE: That settings backup has an invalid console.
BACKUP_BAD_HDMI: That settings backup has an invalid hdmi.
BACKUP_BAD_STATUS_TEXT_PORTRAIT: That settings backup has an invalid status_text_portrait.
BACKUP_BAD_STATUS_TEXT_LANDSCAPE: That settings backup has an invalid status_text_landscape.
BACKUP_BAD_BAR_GAP_PORTRAIT: That settings backup has an invalid bar_gap_portrait.
BACKUP_BAD_BAR_GAP_LANDSCAPE: That settings backup has an invalid bar_gap_landscape.
BACKUP_BAD_STRIP_PORTRAIT: That settings backup has an invalid strip_portrait.
BACKUP_BAD_STRIP_LANDSCAPE: That settings backup has an invalid strip_landscape.
BACKUP_BAD_THEME: That settings backup has an invalid theme.
BACKUP_MISSING: That settings backup is not on this device.
BACKUP_BAD_JSON: That settings backup is not valid JSON.
BACKUP_BAD_SCHEMA: That settings backup is not a schema 1 snapshot.
